newsitem.title: USA: Tyson lobbyist indicted in Espy probe.
newsitem.headline: Tyson lobbyist indicted in Espy probe.

text.p: A federal grand jury returned an indictment Tuesday against Tyson Foods Washington lobbyist Jack Williams as part of the two-year investigation into former Agriculture Secretary Mike Espy, a spokesman for the Independent Counsel heading the probe said.

Williams was charged with making false statements to the FBI and USDA's office of the inspector general in the preliminary investigation of Espy, said Charles Bakaly, spokesman for Independent Counsel Donald Smaltz.
The indictment said Williams reported directly to Archie Shaffer, media, government and public affairs director of Arkansas-based Tyson Foods, the country's largest poultry processor, Bakaly said.
Shaffer in turn reported to John Tyson, who reported to his father, Tyson Foods chairman Don Tyson, the indictment said.
